name: |0⟩ explodes an H-box
summary: A phase-free X-state (|0⟩) on an H-box disconnects it into phase-free Z-states.
description:
Plugging the computational basis state $|0\rangle$ (a phase-free arity-1 X-spider) into one leg of an H-box removes the H-box: whatever the label, all entries of the remaining tensor are $1$, so the result is a product of phase-free Z-states $|0\rangle+|1\rangle$ on the other legs. In terms of AND gates: if one input is $0$, the output does not depend on the other inputs.

This is the special case of the [ZH bialgebra](../zh-bialgebra/) rule where the X-spider has no other legs. It also holds for an H-box with an arbitrary label. Compare [|1⟩ is absorbed](../zh-h-box-absorbs-one/).
parameter_notes: Shown for an H-box with n = 2 other legs; holds for any n.
notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
